column1: # PostgreSQL 17.11 (wadjet-pg-ps1, psql -At raw text, rows sorted) for testdata/arc_ps_display_scale_cells.tsv.

# i11_*: ADR-0013 item 11 — PostgreSQL's answer to the statement with the set operation fenced (`… UNION SELECT v FROM rv_n OFFSET 0) s …`), which tests the representative the set operation chose; unfenced its planner tests each arm's own text first and answers 5 and 0 (measured 17.11, 2026-10-06).

# r_*: which of two equal values (7 / 7.00, -0 / 0) a dedup or grouping keeps (#1713). PostgreSQL 17.11 (postgres:17-alpine, --locale=C, UTF8, 2026-11-24): its DEFAULT plan's answer, a HashAggregate / HashSetOp over the arms in order (first occurrence in arm, then scan, order); with enable_hashagg=off the Sort / Merge Append plans keep a different member for r_union_text, r_union_text_swapped, r_union_all_distinct, r_group_key, r_group_key_swapped, r_intersect, r_intersect_all and r_big_*. r_float_* and r_union_count_zero answer the same under both plans.

# r_except_all, s_*: #1713b's representation-sensitive cells per construct (EXCEPT ALL, arms swapped, LIKE / length / a join on the text, GROUP BY with aggregates and HAVING, grouping sets, two-column keys whose smaller spellings sit in different members, float -0 met second). PostgreSQL 17.11 (postgres:17-alpine, --locale=C, UTF8, 2026-11-24): its DEFAULT plan's answer (a predicate over a set operation's or a grouping's text: the statement FENCED, `OFFSET 0`, as for the i11_* cells); where the engine's representative rule answers otherwise the kept answer is in psDisplayScaleKept (ADR-0024's 2026-11-24 amendment).
